verdict.rationale: MailerSend is a SaaS email platform that handles customer and recipient data, so an AI-training opt-out or data-use policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has nothing about AI training, data-use opt-outs, or a privacy policy on model training. The only AI-related item (connecting to Claude or Gemini) is an adjacent integration feature, not a data-training control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
